async function getData(page) {
  let url = 'https://api.sbis.ru/retail/nomenclature/list?';
  const params = new URLSearchParams(
    {
      'pointId': 131,
      'priceListId': 48,
      'withBalance': true,
      'page': 0,
      'pageSize': 300
    }
  );

  params.set('page', page);

  url += params.toString();

  // console.log(url);
  const response = await fetch(url, {
    method: 'GET',
    headers: {
      'X-SBISAccessToken': 'Nml0UjFEPy14c3NDTWdZSkRwRi9PL2ZWamEqVCZWKGtwSyg6YTkvZi9LTZwKUM8U14lX2Q8LDIvYl9PKCRWMDIwMjMtMDctMjAgMjA6MDI6MzYuMjE0MTk0',
      'Content-Type': 'application/json'
    }
  });
  const data = await response.json();

  if (data.outcome.hasMore) {
    let d = [];
    d = d.concat(getData(page + 1));
    console.log(d);
    return getData(page + 1);
  }



}
